title: Brazilian Stew Eggplant
description: A hearty and flavorful Brazilian-inspired stew made with eggplant and a blend of spices, perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add diced hot pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add stew, tomato paste, salt, and black pepper.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook for 20-25 minutes.
Add sliced eggplant and continue to cook for 10-15 minutes, or until tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
